title: Chicken Chirashi Bowl
description: A Japanese-inspired dish featuring chicken, sushi rice, and vegetables, perfect for a light lunch.

ingredients.name: Mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, green onions)

instructions: Cook sushi rice according to package instructions.
Season chicken with salt and pepper. Cook in warm sesame oil until browned and cooked through.
Prepare mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, green onions) by slicing into thin strips.
To assemble the chirashi bowl, place a scoop of sushi rice in the bottom of a bowl.
Add cooked chicken on top of the rice.
Arrange mixed vegetables around the chicken.
Drizzle chirashi sauce over the top.
Garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.
